value.rationale: This is a natural exact periodic-forcing variation of a classical integrable recurrence. It proves a qualitatively sharp change from decreasing to increasing rotation frequency at the hexagon/heptagon geometry transition, with an interval of frequencies realized at two distinct energies. That geometry-to-twist mechanism is not a routine finite computation or a mere substitution into the autonomous map; it also gives all rational primitive periods, exact unique integer-orbit classification on infinitely many shells, and a concrete 18-period resonance on two energy levels. Such precise integrable nonmonotone structure is mathematically motivated by the nonautonomous Lyness literature.
